partners.name: Rajasthan Association of North America (RANA)
partners.note: Refreshed 2026-10-12: RANA re-ordered the flag letters in Aug 2025 (India 2nd, USA last); the 2024 MoU mark had them the other way round. ranausa.org (Woodbury NY) is the MoU signatory; rana.org is a different body (Rajasthan Alliance of North America, Bay Area).

partners.note: Jodhpur. Logo is the letterhead banner from the 2024 MoU; www.rajasthaniyuvasamiti.com (printed on it) no longer resolves (2026-10-12), X account is the live presence.

partners.name: Rajasthan Charitable Trust UK (RCTUK)
partners.note: Site mark (blue hexagon, camels) matches ours (2026-10-12); ours still carries the WordPress-era red caption.

partners.note: Auckland; also facebook.com/profile.php?id=61555767819964, instagram.com/rajasthan.nz, ractnz@gmail.com. Site is a JS app; the favicon SVG is the only directly fetchable mark.
